rules.C: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round; C_h the same over host h's cells
rules.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
rules.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
rules.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
rules.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round, median dM and C per arm; S and C per host; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; energy shares, remainder shares, tilt errors; the S and C of each null, pooled and per host; the round-action table; change norm of every arm relative to full
rules.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); abc_s0375 / rem_p3_s0437 / rnull3_s0437_1 / cs_s0312 = the M14 arms (same patch fields) on the 6 M14 subset cells: their 4 x 12 rows equal M14's bitwise; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M14 and no claim
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: Q1_GAIN C30_ONLY: M14's lower threshold of the AB patch comes from dropping c at 30, not from confining the shift; LOC_ONLY: it comes from confining the shift to the author and block lines; BOTH: each lowers it on the informative hosts. NULL24 HARM_BEYOND_NULL24 on 264c458d: M14's 264c458d tilt result survives three times as many nulls. DOSE_OPPOSES on 264c458d with lam -2 and +2 in between: the opposition is graded in lam. All arms except full are pooled-donor arms (effectively 8 host replicates, 3 responding); per-host S is the honest unit; every informative verdict rests on 264c458d or 4bcbaf15; comparisons with M13 / M14 rows are valid because the replay arms are bitwise equal
rules.null24: at s = 7/16, N24 = the 8 M14 nulls rnull3_s0437_1-8 and the 16 M15 nulls rnull3_s0437_9-24 (c + 3q, q orthogonal to c with ||q|| = ||r|| per row and position, random direction, seed A461_M14_RNULL|16|donor|host|i). Per responsive host h: informative unless the host S of M14's rem_p3 and rem_m3 and all 24 nulls are all 0 or all equal to h's cell count. On informative hosts add = S_h(rem_p3_s0437): HARM_BEYOND_NULL24 iff add < min N24, LESS_HARM_THAN_NULL24 iff add > max N24, else AT; remove = S_h(rem_m3_s0437): REMOVAL_BEYOND_NULL24 iff remove > max N24, REMOVAL_BELOW_NULL24 iff remove < min N24, else AT. The rank (number of nulls with S_h <= add, and >= remove) is reported. The same with C_h on every responsive host gives the C test. NULL24_BY_HOST lists both; pooled NULL24_S and NULL24_C: DIRECTION_SPECIFIC iff some BEYOND and no LESS_HARM / REMOVAL_BELOW, NOT_SPECIFIC iff all AT, REVERSED iff some LESS_HARM / REMOVAL_BELOW and no BEYOND, else MIXED; UNINFORMATIVE iff no host is informative
rules.q1_split: four families of the common shift (t = 1) with contrast size s in 1/4, 3/8, 1/2: AB29 = shift at 0-12 + 29-30, c_30 weight 0 (M14 abc_<s>); AB30 = shift at 0-12 + 29-30, c at 29 and 30 (M15 abc30_<s>); ALL29 = shift at all 31 positions, c_30 weight 0 (M15 csc29_<s>); ALL30 = shift at all 31 positions, c at 29 and 30 (M13 cs_s025 / cs_s0375 / cs_s05). Per responsive host and family: SMIN = the smallest s with host S >= 7 (NONE above 1/2 if none). Per host: C30 effect = sign(SMIN(AB30) - SMIN(AB29)) and sign(SMIN(ALL30) - SMIN(ALL29)); LOC effect = sign(SMIN(ALL29) - SMIN(AB29)) and sign(SMIN(ALL30) - SMIN(AB30)). C30_BY_HOST: C30_COSTS iff both signs > 0, C30_COSTS_UNDER_AB iff only the AB sign > 0 and the ALL sign = 0, C30_COSTS_UNDER_ALL iff only the ALL sign > 0 and the AB sign = 0, C30_NO_COST iff both 0, else C30_MIXED. LOC_BY_HOST: AB_LOWERS iff both LOC signs > 0, AB_LOWERS_WITHOUT_C30 iff only the c-29 sign > 0 and the other 0, AB_LOWERS_WITH_C30 iff only the c-29-30 sign > 0 and the other 0, LOC_NO_EFFECT iff both 0, else LOC_MIXED. Pooled over the two informative hosts 264c458d and 4bcbaf15 (the hosts where M14 found SMIN(AB29) < SMIN(ALL30)): Q1_GAIN = C30_ONLY iff both are C30_COSTS* and LOC_NO_EFFECT, LOC_ONLY iff both LOC lowers* and C30_NO_COST, BOTH iff both have a C30 cost and an AB lowering, else Q1_GAIN_MIXED. Per-host S of every family at every s and per-host C are reported
rules.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
rules.responsive_host: a host where S(cs1) on its cells exceeds half its cells, with cs1 read from the pinned M13 raw rows (1fb5651c, 264c458d, 4bcbaf15 in M13 and M14)
rules.round_action: always reported for every s = 7/16 tilt and null arm and per responsive host: the number of cells where the main patch is JOINT, where the round patch has M > 0, where it has A > 0, and the median A of the round patch (the M14 exploratory addendum, now fixed in advance); ROUND_A_RANK_264C = the number of the 24 nulls whose round-A>0 count on 264c458d is >= that of rem_p3_s0437, and <= that of rem_m3_s0437
rules.size_gate: every tilt arm and null keeps c's component along c and has tilt norm |lam| ||r|| (nulls: 3 ||r||) within 1e-6 relative to ||c|| (fail-closed, as M13-M14); the abc_s0375 and csc29 arms set c_30 to 0 exactly
rules.tilt_dose: at s = 7/16, S and C per host and pooled over lam -3, -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +3 (lam -3, -1, 0, +1, +3 from M14's rem_m3_s0437 / rem_m1_s0437 / cs_s0437 / rem_p1_s0437 / rem_p3_s0437, lam -2, +2 from M15): DOSE_OPPOSES iff S is non-increasing in lam and S(-3) > S(+3), DOSE_SUPPORTS iff non-decreasing and S(-3) < S(+3), DOSE_NO_EFFECT iff all equal, else DOSE_MIXED; per host as DOSE_BY_HOST, pooled as DOSE_S0437
rules.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
